plugin.name: Splinter Cell Double Agent Fusion Fix
GRAPHICS.ShadowMapResolutionMultiplier.d: Multiplier for shadow map resolution. Higher values increase shadow quality but may reduce performance. Multiplier range: (0-16). Restart required.
GRAPHICS.GlowResolutionMultiplier.descri: Multiplier for glow effect resolution. Higher values increase glow quality but may reduce performance. Multiplier range: (0-16). Restart required.
GRAPHICS.MirrorResolutionMultiplier.desc: Multiplier for reflection resolution. Higher values increase reflection quality but may reduce performance. Multiplier range: (0-16). Restart required.
MAIN.ResX.description: Startup width in pixels. If either resolution value is 0, use the desktop resolution. The in-game resolution selector also updates these values. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Startup height in pixels. If either resolution value is 0, use the desktop resolution. The in-game resolution selector also updates these values. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement without the original dropped events. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouseRawData.description: Use unaccelerated mouse movement. Restart required.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto puts the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 keeps it in a centred box; 4:3 is the original layout. Applies to the HUD after the next loading screen.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Caps the frame rate, at most 60 FPS; -1 follows the monitor refresh rate up to 60. Higher rates are not offered because AI and physics misbehave above 60 FPS. Applies immediately.
BONUS.BlacklistIndicators.description: Make the goggles and suit lights respond to visibility: 0 keeps the original lights, 1 brightens them in darkness, and 2 brightens them in light. Restart required.
BONUS.GogglesLightColor.description: Color of the goggles and suit lights. Original keeps the game's lights, which change with your visibility; the other colors are the suit light colors from Splinter Cell Blacklist. Restart required.
BONUS.LightSyncRGB.description: Only Logitech hardware is supported. Requires the Logitech G HUB app. Restart required.
MISC.EnableRunDuringForcedWalk.descripti: Allows running during forced walk sections. Restart required.
MAIN.DisablePreCache.description: Experimental: improve loading times by disabling pre cache (may cause issues with certain sounds not loading). Restart required.
MISC.SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos and intro videos. Story videos still play. Restart required.
MAIN.SingleCoreAffinity.description: Experimental: attempts to avoid mid-loading hangs (may cause performance issues). Restart required.
GRAPHICS.BrighterLights.description: Doubles the brightness of dynamic lights. Off keeps the original lighting. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.ShadowDrawDistance.description: Keeps dynamic shadows and lights visible four times farther away than the game's highest setting. Off keeps the original distance. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.BlurEnabled.description: Enable the game blur effect. Turn it off for a sharper image. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.BlurStrength.description: Strength of the blur effect when Blur is enabled. Lower values reduce blur. Restart required.

MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing. Extra widening is limited to 150 degrees across; 1.0 remains neutral.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MAIN.MouseSensitivity.description: Movement multiplier for raw mouse input. Applies immediately; presets preserve your choice.
ui.nativegraphicsoverrides.description: Use the graphics values in the fix's configuration file instead of the choices in the game's Video menu. The game's own files are not changed. Off by default. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.AnisotropicFiltering.descriptio: Keeps textures sharp at steep viewing angles. Off keeps the game's own filtering. Restart required.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pauses the game and its sound while another window is active, as the original does. Off keeps the game running in the background in windowed and borderless modes. Applies immediately.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor. Applies immediately.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
MAIN.SaveLocation.description: Where profiles and saves are kept. ProgramData is the game's own place (ProgramData\Ubisoft\SplinterCell4\Save\Offline, a hidden folder), Documents uses Documents\My Games\Splinter Cell Double Agent, Game Folder the Save folder next to System. Saves are not moved: copy the folders over to keep playing them. Restart required.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Button names in prompts while a pad is used. Auto uses Xbox names; keyboard and mouse input restores keyboard prompts.
MAIN.Vibration.description: Lets the pad rumble with shots, explosions and hits. Applies immediately.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.title: Update available
startup.unsupported: This executable layout is not supported. Install the original retail or Steam version of Splinter Cell Double Agent and the matching current fix. The game will start without the fix.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the chosen resolution (at the desktop resolution it covers the screen, its frame outside it) or a borderless window covering the monitor. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the window mode.
CutsceneBorders.description: Framing of the cinematics, made for a 16:9 picture. Letterbox keeps the original bars on screens narrower than 16:9, Pillarbox puts bars at the sides of wider screens, Both does both. Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
MAIN.GamepadCameraSpeed.description: How fast the right stick turns the camera and aims. Applies immediately.
